dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you playing over here?

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: My dad's a Snezhnayan envoy who's been posted to the Northland Bank. He won't let me run too far off.

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: Look, that's the bank. It's between a clockwork workshop and the clock shop. Pretty awesome, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Veta
dialogues.text: My dad's taught me how to distinguish between good and bad people, so don't worry, I'm not gonna go running off with bad people.
